cheerpj.summary: CheerpJ can run this game provided external dependencies or virtual filesystem assets are staged.
verified_capabilities: Accepts compiled binary JAR input directly without source code.
Bytecode major version 52 (Java 8) is supported by CheerpJ 5.0 runtime.
CheerpJ provides client-side OpenJDK AWT/Swing canvas rendering.
assumptions_and_risks: Browser audio autoplay policy requires user interaction before audio starts.
Direct disk file operations access in-memory CheerpOS virtual filesystem (data resets on refresh unless indexedDB persistence is configured).
workarounds_needed: Requires external NetBeans 'lib/AbsoluteLayout.jar' mounted into CheerpOS filesystem.
Ensure game startup waits for user click or initialize Web Audio context on user gesture.
remediation_steps: Bundle 'AbsoluteLayout.jar' and load it before launching the main JAR.

teavm.summary: TeaVM cannot compile this desktop game directly because Swing and AWT are missing from its class library.
verified_capabilities: Open-source ahead-of-time (AOT) compiler targeting JavaScript and WebAssembly.
assumptions_and_risks: Thread.sleep() and blocking loops require TeaVM asynchronous transformation mode or event-loop refactoring.
blockers: TeaVM does not provide an implementation of 'javax.swing.*' or 'java.awt.*'.
remediation_steps: Port the user interface to TeaVM Canvas / HTML5 DOM or use an AWT-to-Canvas compatibility layer.
Implement custom TeaVM JavaScript overlays using Web Audio API.

swingjs.summary: SwingJS provides high Swing UI compatibility, but requires original or decompiled Java source and Java 8/11 syntax.
verified_capabilities: Open-source Java-to-JavaScript system with comprehensive Swing and AWT emulation.
blockers: SwingJS requires Java source code (.java) for AST transpilation; it cannot compile standalone binary JARs directly.
workarounds_needed: NetBeans AbsoluteLayout source must be included in the SwingJS build classpath.
remediation_steps: Provide original Java source code or decompile the JAR classes using CFR / Fernflower.

key_takeaways: Requires external NetBeans 'lib/AbsoluteLayout.jar' mounted into CheerpOS filesystem.
Ensure game startup waits for user click or initialize Web Audio context on user gesture.
SwingJS is a viable open-source secondary path if source code is decompiled or provided.
TeaVM cannot be used directly due to missing desktop Swing/AWT runtime support.
